patch.summary: Office Timeline migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to Office Timeline by inventorying legacy project-management fields, mapping them to Office Timeline objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Microsoft Powerpoint, Microsoft Project, Excel before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Not a work OS — no monday/Hive-class boards, automations or workload management
Success signal: task boards works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: Office Timeline migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power task boards, timeline / Gantt, docs and collaboration and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into Office Timeline; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Microsoft Powerpoint; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when PMO and project leads who need PowerPoint-native executive timelines/Gantt outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Not a work OS — no monday/Hive-class boards, automations or workload management
If Office Timeline mapping is poor, compare destination fit with monday.com before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Microsoft Powerpoint in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Not a work OS — no monday/Hive-class boards, automations or workload management

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Centre of gravity is PowerPoint presentation timelines, not live team task execution

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Automations and AI assistance are not the product job

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for task boards
Mitigate: Not a work OS — no monday/Hive-class boards, automations or workload management

notes: Migration: cutover risks, data mapping, checklist.
